doc_summary: `native_render_fog(partial, camera, fog_type, fog)` adjusts final FogData after normal environment/effect/render-distance calculation and Horizon's fog option, before GPU upload. Title panoramas skip it. The whole request is accepted only when color components are finite in 0..=1, all distances are finite, environmental and render-distance ends exceed their starts, and sky/cloud ends are nonnegative. Negative near planes remain valid (water/lava). Invalid requests retain the original whole fog. Bundles need "hooks": @API:render_fog@.
